query:
SELECT DISTINCT l1.val AS "val!: String"
           FROM labels l1
           WHERE l1.src = ?1 AND l1.uri = ?2
             AND l1.seq = (
                 SELECT MAX(l2.seq) FROM labels l2
                 WHERE l2.src = l1.src AND l2.uri = l1.uri AND l2.val = l1.val
             )
             AND l1.neg = 0
           ORDER BY l1.val ASC
